resources.string: Films and series already in your own TorBox play here as sources beside your playlists: its finished torrents, usenet and web downloads, matched to the film or episode you choose by their names. Nothing is searched for or added to your TorBox from here.
Use TorBox for films and series
Offer TorBox\'s copy before the playlists\'
Add your TorBox API key: on torbox.app, Settings, then API key. It stays on this phone and isn\'t shown again once saved.
